A.baseline_fares.published_agency_id.description: Acquired operator tariff scope; do not assign this tariff to another agency.

A.baseline_fares.ac_route_pattern.description: Provisional class inference from acquired route labels. This does not prove the assigned departure is air-conditioned.
A.baseline_fares.ac_route_pattern.sweep_basis: Explicit class-assignment sensitivity pending verified route vehicle assignments and passenger eligibility.

A.baseline_fares.rider_class.description: Adult-priced development population pending verified concessions and pass ownership; not an observed eligibility assignment.
A.baseline_fares.rider_class.sweep_basis: Explicit class-assignment sensitivity pending verified route vehicle assignments and passenger eligibility.

A.baseline_fares.fallback_rate_money_per.description: Retain the previous baseline PT rate on unpriced operators/submodes; these are explicit proxies, not observed tariffs.
A.baseline_fares.fallback_rate_money_per.sweep_basis: Provisional uncovered-tariff uncertainty; replace with acquired and validated operator tables.
